description: This file implements a plugin for the RDK-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) service API. It defines the TextToSpeech class which registers several methods (e.g., enabletts, listvoices, speak, cancel) for controlling TTS functionalities, manages configuration, and handles communication with the underlying TTS engine via TTSManager and TTSEventCallback. It also includes licensing information, plugin registration, and method implementations for TTS API operations.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: Main plugin class handling TTS API methods, configuration, and event notification.

classes.name: TTSEventCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling TTS engine events (not fully detailed in provided snippet).

methods.name: uint32_t enabletts(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS based on provided parameter.

methods.name: uint32_t listvoices(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: uint32_t setttsconfiguration(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Sets TTS configuration parameters such as endpoint, language, voice, volume, and rate.

methods.name: uint32_t speak(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis of provided text and returns a speech ID.

methods.name: uint32_t cancel(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Cancels a speech output given a speech ID.

methods.name: uint32_t pause(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech for a given speech ID.

methods.name: uint32_t resume(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Resumes paused speech for a given speech ID.

methods.name: uint32_t isspeaking(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Checks if a given speech ID is currently speaking.

methods.name: uint32_t getspeechstate(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a speech (e.g., playing, paused).
